_mrd.title: Complete Current-State kis-mcp-doc Human Documentation Programme

content.outcome: Implement a complete, current, deterministic human projection of kis-mcp-doc machine/executable truth plus an extensible artefact metadata and relationship graph for agents, drift detection, and future impact assessment.
programme_principles: Work Management remains a separate parent-KIS-facing documentation/specification family and is not redesigned by this programme.
Governance, Documentation Reference Standard, repository/MRD architecture, publication, site, search, release, verification and public-repository operation belong to the kis-mcp-doc human bundle.
The bundle describes current repository state at a revision; it is not a progressive history of Changes 001-020.
MRDs, code, schemas, contracts, configuration, policies, hooks, Actions, tests, verification, manifests, lockfiles and governed provider/repository state remain authoritative.
Human documentation is a deterministic non-writeback projection and must be understandable without reading the underlying machine artefacts.
No HRD-MRD co-authority binding is introduced; useful binding concepts are represented as lineage and typed relationships.

classification.reason: Large governed Knowledge/Docs change spanning repository metadata, generated human documentation, publication/search/site/release integration, deterministic drift controls, and CI-visible generated outputs.

authority_model: Existing canonical machine-readable and executable repository sources retain authority.
Generated human documentation MUST NOT become write-back authority.
Typed graph relationships express lineage, dependency, implementation, validation, publication and authority direction without creating HRD co-authority.
Exact Git/GitHub revision identity is evidence for an artefact instance, not a replacement for semantic ownership.
metadata_policy: The initial envelope is approved as useful rather than over-specified.
Populate fields from existing truth where available; do not fabricate values merely to fill the envelope.
The model MUST permit additive extension as new agent, graph, freshness, impact, validation or publication use cases are discovered.
Machine metadata is optimized for stable identity, discovery and graph traversal; it need not be aesthetically human-readable.
Human renderers translate machine identifiers and relationships into explanatory prose where useful.
lineage_model: Use stable logical artefact identity plus exact repository/path/revision/content identity.
Use content hashes, source fingerprints and manifests for deterministic lineage and freshness.

Do not embed a final containing Git commit or self blob hash where that creates circular identity; bind committed artefacts through manifests/Git and expose exact source commits in post-commit Pages/release artefacts.
Typed relationship and authority direction enables downstream reconciliation and stale-artifact detection.
requirements: R1: Work Management MUST remain separately presented and outside the kis-mcp-doc repository HRD consolidation scope.
R2: The future kis-mcp-doc human bundle MUST completely reflect human-relevant current repository truth at the exact represented revision.
R3: The future artefact inventory MUST expose the approved metadata envelope from existing machine truth and support typed graph traversal.
R4: Authority/canonical ownership MUST remain distinct from dependency and relationship semantics.
R5: Exact Git/GitHub identity, hashes, source fingerprints and manifests MUST support deterministic lineage and stale/drift evaluation.
R6: Future completion gates MUST prevent human documentation from silently lagging human-relevant governed repository changes.
R7: The graph and impact relationships SHOULD provide a reusable deterministic substrate for future Change Ready AI impact assessment, without requiring that AI feature in this programme.
R8: Implementation MUST preserve the five approved programme slices and close only after repository coverage, generation, publication integration, and human-verifiability checks pass.
implementation_plan: Slice A: establish repository artefact metadata and relationship graph.
Slice B: generate the complete current-state kis-mcp-doc human specification/documentation bundle.
Slice C: enforce deterministic lineage, freshness and drift controls.
Slice D: integrate the repository bundle with site, search and publication/release surfaces.
Slice E: perform repository coverage and human-verifiability closeout audit.
verification_criteria: V1: Change 021 scope and MRD validate as an active governed implementation record.
V2: Parent issue #51 exists with child issues #52-#56 linked as GitHub sub-issues and Work Management capture/claim is reconciled.
V3: The repository-docs family deterministically generates a human bundle, artefact inventory, relationship graph, coverage report, manifest, site routes, search index, and release package.
V4: Work Management domain authority remains excluded from repository HRD consolidation.
V5: Focused tests, full repository verification, specialist reviews, exact-head CI, merge, and post-merge documentation reconciliation complete before Done.

tasks.text: Repository artefact metadata and relationship graph.
Complete current-state kis-mcp-doc human specification bundle.
Deterministic lineage, freshness and drift enforcement.
Repository documentation site, search and publication integration.
Repository coverage audit and human-verifiability closeout.

risks: A consolidated human bundle could accidentally be treated as authority; one-way machine-to-human projection and deterministic generation must remain explicit.
An over-eager graph harvester could infer relationships not supported by canonical evidence; first implementation must distinguish observed facts from derived relationships.
Git commit identity can create circularity if embedded before the containing commit exists; use manifest/Git binding and post-commit publication metadata.
explicit_exclusions: Redesigning or consolidating the Work Management HRD/specification family.
Creating a Change 001-020 retrospective human history.

verification: Issue #51 was reconciled into the configured kis-mcp-doc Project and claimed by kis-op.
Repository-docs implementation, deterministic inventory/graph generation, and publication integration are implemented locally; final verification/review/PR evidence is pending.
